notes: All 12 views inspected. Rejected on usability, not rights. The upstream model is a wall/floor display piece: the machete with a riveted grip is welded to a rectangular wooden display board with two raised cradles. The GLB contains a single mesh with a single material and no separate node for the furniture, so the stand cannot be hidden, deleted or unparented without destructive mesh surgery. The bottom view is entirely the stand. A weapon that cannot be separated from its plinth cannot be equipped, holstered or held by a character, which is the primary use for this category. The sculpt and materials themselves are clean.
method: Visual inspection of local-model renders and technical reports
